name: gizza-ai/fernet-token
summary: Create or read Fernet tokens (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256)

tool.description: Create, read, or inspect Fernet symmetric tokens (AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 with an embedded timestamp). encrypt turns text into a url-safe token (blank key = generate one); decrypt verifies and reads it back, with optional TTL; inspect shows the token structure without the key.

text.description: On encrypt: the text to protect. On decrypt: the Fernet token to read.

key.description: The Fernet key: url-safe base64 of 32 bytes. Required for decrypt. On encrypt, leave blank to generate a fresh key (returned in the response).

mode.description: encrypt (default) turns text into a Fernet token; decrypt reads a token back into text; inspect shows a token's structure (version, timestamp, IV, sizes) without the key, and validates the HMAC if a key is given.

ttl.description: Decrypt only: max token age in seconds. 0 (default) disables the age check; a positive value rejects tokens older than this (or with a future timestamp).
